standard_prerequisites.name: Split triangles
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-split, cited at proof lines 5033 and 5038; complete proof at source lines 916-927, queued for separate carding
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the split triangle X -> X + Y -> Y -> X[1] and the identification of the middle triangle with a direct sum.

standard_prerequisites.name: Two-out-of-three for definedness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-2-out-of-3-defined (carded in this batch, L26162), cited at proof line 5034
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that RF defined at X and Y implies defined at X + Y with the split triangle.

standard_prerequisites.name: Arrows inverted by localization
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: categories-lemma-what-gets-inverted, cross-chapter citation at proof line 5047 (tags mechanism)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that saturated S is exactly the set of arrows inverted by Q, giving s + s' in S.

standard_prerequisites.name: Filteredness of slice categories and products
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: categories-remark-left-localization-morphisms-colimit and categories-lemma-essentially-constant-over-product, cross-chapter citations at proof lines 5055-5058 (tags mechanism)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies X/S, Y/S, (X + Y)/S filtered and the product criterion for essential constancy.

standard_prerequisites.name: Direct sums of essentially constant systems
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: homology-lemma-direct-sum-from-product-essentially-constant, cross-chapter citation at proof line 5070 (tags mechanism; Karoubian hypothesis enters here)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that essential constancy of the direct sum system implies essential constancy of both summand systems.

core_obligations: (1)：由 split 三角形与 lemma-2-out-of-3-defined 得 RF 定义于 X⊕Y 且有分裂三角形；再用一次 lemma-split 读出 RF(X⊕Y)=RF(X)⊕RF(Y)（5032-5040 行）。
(2) 前半：饱和系统=Q 反转的态射（categories-lemma-what-gets-inverted），故 s⊕s'∈S，得函子 X/S×Y/S→(X⊕Y)/S（5043-5053 行）。
(2) 后半：证明该函子共尾——part (1) 由 MS2 方图（5081-5091 行）；part (2) 由 X/S、Y/S 过滤性选 a,b,c,d∈S，再在局部化中取等化子 X'→X''、Y'→Y''（5092-5105 行）。
收尾：共尾性+ essentially-constant-over-product + direct-sum-from-product（Karoubian 用点）得 RF 定义于 X 与 Y（5063-5077 行）。
proof_roadmap: (2)：饱和性刻画、函子构造、共尾性两部件、本质恒定性化归（5042-5105 行）。
difficulty_reason: 主体是共尾性两部件的显式构造（MS2 方图与等化子替换），化归链由五个跨章引理承担但每步的实例化数据都写明。
